Method of Attack: Encryption of files on targeted systems
Use of Trojanized files for spreading malware
Exploitation of vulnerabilities for initial access and privilege escalation
Network reconnaissance and lateral movement via shell commands and payload deployment
Ransom demand in Bitcoin with communication via Proton Mail
Threats to leak stolen data to coerce ransom payment
Discoverer: Republic of Korea National Intelligence Service and Defense Security Agency
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerabilities including Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228), SonicWall RCE (CVE-2021-20038), TerraMaster admin password disclosure (CVE-2022-24990)
Use of fake personas and accounts
Use of VPN services, virtual private servers (VPS), and third-country IP addresses to conceal origin
Indicators of Compromise: Use of Proton Mail accounts for ransom communication
